verdicts.reason: A turns the design into a left-to-right banner, but the headline is oversized and jammed against the left and bottom edges with almost no margin. 'sunshine.' nearly touches the right column, and the small CTA sits cramped in the bottom-right corner. B is just a shrunk, centred copy of the original: the subline 'Now in four flavours.' and the CTA label are tiny to the point of illegibility, and big empty side areas waste the wide format.
